summary.text: Nick Archer is a Republican who represents Oklahoma House District 55, elected in 2022. In the 60th Legislature he is Majority Caucus Vice Chair.

paragraphs.text: Archer was born in Sayre, Oklahoma, and shortly moved to Elk City, where he graduated from high school.
He attended the University of Oklahoma, where he earned a bachelor’s degree in architecture.
In 2013 Archer and his wife, Katie, returned to western Oklahoma, and he joined Leadership Elk City.
He serves as director of engineering at Great Plains Analytical Services, served on the Elk City Planning and Zoning Commission, and in 2019 was elected mayor of Elk City for two terms.
Archer and Katie have two children, Alexander and Emilia.
